work.permit: permiso individual del Ministro de Trabajo

note: Majority: null. The Civil Code's article on majority was not read: the Consultoría Jurídica del Poder Ejecutivo (consultoria.gov.do) serves its pages behind Cloudflare, and the Ministry of Labour's legal page carries only the Constitution and the Labour Code. The Constitution of 13 June 2015 (Ministry of Labour's copy), art. 21, gives citizenship to Dominicans who have turned 18 or are or have been married; that is citizenship, not civil majority, so it isn't held as majority. Work: Código de Trabajo (Ley 16-92, promulgated 29 May 1992; the Ministry of Labour's 2024 upload of its edition with the regulations), art. 245: the work of minors under fourteen is prohibited; arts. 246-252 limit minors under 16 (no night work, no dangerous or unhealthy work). Performers: art. 245: in the interest of art, science or teaching, the Secretary of State (now Minister) of Labour may, by individual permits, authorise minors under fourteen to be employed in public shows, radio, television or films as actors or extras; art. 250: minors from fourteen to sixteen may work in concerts or theatre shows until midnight with the Labour Department's prior authorisation, which the form doesn't hold. No lowest age is set. Service: Ley Orgánica de las Fuerzas Armadas, Ley 139-13 (the Ministry of Defence's copy, mide.gob.do), art. 96: entry to the Armed Forces is voluntary in peacetime, and obligatory or forced only when a state of exception is declared under the Constitution; art. 97: enlisted men from 18 to under 23 (16 to 18 with the parents' authorisation). The form holds none; the call-up in a state of exception is not held.

sources.title: Código de Trabajo de la República Dominicana, Ley 16-92 (Ministerio de Trabajo)
sources.said: Art. 245.- Se prohibe el trabajo de menores de catorce años. No obstante, en beneficio del arte, de la ciencia o de la enseñanza, el Secretario de Estado de Trabajo, por medio de permisos individuales, podrá autorizar que menores de catorce años puedan ser empleados en espectáculos públicos, radio, televisión o películas cinematográficas como actores o figurantes.

sources.title: Ley Orgánica de las Fuerzas Armadas de la República Dominicana, Ley 139-13 (Ministerio de Defensa)
sources.said: Artículo 96.- Ingreso Voluntario. El ingreso a las Fuerzas Armadas será voluntario en tiempo de paz y obligatorio o forzoso cuando sea declarado el estado de excepción, de acuerdo con lo establecido en la Constitución de la República.
